results.reasoning: Judged 2026-09-15 on the scratch copy judge-0915 at :4730, in both deliveries, with two position-pinned fixtures filed on the copy's stand-in review page (n-0309, and n-0313 whose body names n-0309, n-0133, a rule id and an evidence key, with line breaks, plus three replies).
